satellites.title: Seeking What is Hidden
satellites.evidence: The 繫辭 of the Yijing says 探賾索隱. The textual pairing is a strong reason to bring 探 into Seeking.

satellites.title: The Pearl Beneath the Black Dragon’s Chin
satellites.evidence: Zhuangzi 32 (Lie Yukou): 千金之珠，必在九重之淵而驪龍頷下 — a pearl worth a thousand gold lies in the ninefold deep under the chin of the black dragon. The idiom 探驪得珠, reaching under the dragon for the pearl, comes from this story.
satellites.caveat: In the story the pearl was taken while the dragon slept, and the tale is a warning; the idiom’s praise of a successful search is later.
